articles.title: Belasí v Lige majstrov schytali debakel. Favorizovaný Rím dominoval na ihrisku a Slovan zdolal rozdielom triedy
articles.en: Belasí suffer a debacle in the Champions League. Favourites Rome dominated on the pitch and Slovan beat them by a class difference
